data.detailed_description:

Thank you guys for all the support! <3


Notas da Atualização

Patch 1.1 Updates:
After watching several play-through videos as well as continuing to test the game on our end, we addressed some bugs that we thought should be fixed. Changes made in this update include:

-Fixed the falling animation loop bug
-Adjusted faulty Camera Angles in several areas
-Updated the Reveal mechanic to make it easier to understand and use
-Solved the issue where Black Oco would get stuck to Halia’s hand sometimes when trying to throw
-Cleaned up many audio bugs including stacking music audio tracks
-Changed a puzzle to be a little more thoughtful
-Additional other small bugs

Hope this makes your game experience cleaner! Thank you for playing! =)
Sincerely,
Project Polish Production Dev Team


Controller Required

Controller is required to play Hollowed. No keyboard and mouse support.


Acerca do jogo

Hollowed tells the story of a woman who will do anything to bring her perished loved one back to the world of the living. The player will control a humanoid character named Halia as well as a spirit named Oco simultaneously on one controller. These two characters are tethered together by a spiritual connection and they must work together to progress through the daunting challenge of bringing Halia's loved one back to the world of the living. While Halia has the ability to jump and move like most platforming character, Oco has the ability to help Halia in her endeavors through four unique abilities. Use these abilities to interact with the environment and Halia in order to progress through platforming puzzles in this 3D side-scrolling adventure.

The mechanics allow for a new way of exploring the side-scrolling genre by asking the player to control two characters simultaneously. Halia's controls take up the left side of the controller while Oco's controls take up the right side of the joystick. It is only through the synchronous collaboration between these two characters that the players will succeed in helping Halia save her loved one.

Features seven original soundtracks, fully rendered stylized 3D environment with hidden secrets for the player to uncover, and a story that explore the deep emotions of grief.

reviews.review:
Hollowed is a short puzzle platformer that caught my attention because of the way it handles its main character. I play as Halia, a woman trying to bring her dead loved one back to life, while also controlling her spirit Oco at the same time. Both characters are connected, and I have to use them together to get through the different areas. It is a pretty unusual setup for a platformer, and I think it gives the game enough of its own identity to stand out.

The best part for me is controlling Halia and Oco together. Halia handles the normal movement and jumping, while Oco has four different abilities that I use to interact with the environment and help Halia get through obstacles. I like the idea because I am not simply controlling two characters separately. I have to think about what both of them are doing at the same time. Some puzzles make good use of that connection and give me a nice feeling when I finally understand what the game wants me to do.

The world is also one of the stronger parts. The game uses fully rendered 3D environments while keeping the gameplay in a side scrolling format, and there are hidden areas and secrets for me to find. The strange fantasy setting fits the story about grief and trying to bring someone back from the dead. There are seven original pieces of music as well, and I think the atmosphere benefits from keeping things fairly quiet and mysterious rather than constantly filling the screen with action.

The biggest problem is that Hollowed is very short. The developers originally described the experience as being around an hour and a half to two hours, and that feels about right for the kind of compact adventure this is. I actually think the short length suits the story, but it also means the game does not have much room to develop its mechanics. Just when I am becoming comfortable with the way Halia and Oco work together, I am already getting close to the end. I would have liked a few more puzzles that really pushed the dual character idea further.

The controls are another thing I have to consider. Hollowed requires a controller, with Halia using the left side and Oco using the right side of the controller. I think this is a sensible choice for the two character system, but it does mean I cannot just pick it up with a keyboard and mouse. There were also some technical issues that needed fixing after release, including camera problems, audio bugs, collision issues and problems with Oco getting stuck. The developers did patch several of these issues, which helps, but I still think the game can feel a little rough around the edges.

I also think the story is more interesting as an emotional idea than as a fully developed narrative. The basic motivation is strong enough to keep me curious, and the themes of grief and loss fit the strange world well, but there is not enough time for every part of the story to get the development it could have had. That is not necessarily a deal breaker for me because the game seems deliberately interested in leaving some things open to interpretation. I just think the limited length makes the story feel more like a short emotional experience than a full adventure.

Overall, Hollowed is a creative free puzzle platformer that does a good job building its whole experience around the relationship between Halia and Oco. I like the unusual controls, atmospheric world, puzzle design and emotional premise, and I think the fact that I am controlling both characters at once gives the game a mechanic worth remembering. The short length, occasional roughness and limited depth keep it from reaching the higher ratings I give to more complete puzzle adventures, but there is still a lot to like here. For a free game that can be finished in a couple of hours, I think Hollowed is well worth trying if I want something unusual and focused.

Rating: 7.6/10
